description: This file defines the OAuthSubscriber class, which is an event subscriber for handling OAuth2 authentication and authorization within the OrangeHRM system. It intercepts request events to validate access tokens, set user credentials, and manages error responses for OAuth-related issues.

classes.name: OAuthSubscriber
classes.description: Handles OAuth2 token validation and user authentication within the system, subscribing to kernel request and response events to enforce security checks.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically request and response events.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of AuthenticationService.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Intercepts incoming requests, checks for OAuth authorization header, validates tokens, and sets user credentials.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during OAuth validation, responding with JSON error if appropriate or throwing session expiration.

methods.name: onResponseEvent
methods.description: Invalidates the session if OAuth authorization was used and user is authenticated, during the response event.
